messages:
alex: heads-up — hit a repro for a quality regression after enabling the new FP8 kernel on L40S for long-context (>4k) mixed-precision runs.
alex: baseline (FP16) vs FP8-canary: eval perplexity +2.3, squad-like EM down ~3.1% on our longctx set. short-context tests look fine.
maria: saw that too in the logs, layer 21/22 activations clip spikes. stack trace points at kernel tiling path for KV cache extension.
liam: quick repro (ran on l40s-prod-canary):
liam: ```
# run reproducer
export MODEL=redwood/13b-cp
python -m bench.eval_longctx --model $MODEL --seq_len 8192 --batch 4 --precision fp8_kernel
```
liam: observe logits drift after first 2k tokens (not just perf noise) — histograms shift and softmax temp changes.
devon: interesting that H100 FP8 path is ok — suggests tiling/stride or load/store ordering on L40S kernel differs.
devon: possible suspects: per-channel scale persistence, activation quant clamp, kv-tiling boundary condition when old_kv_len > new_chunk.
maria: I dumped intermediate scales from commit 5812 and saw scale_m updates zeroed at chunk boundary.
jin: ran a small canary rollback to fp16 for the failing slice and metrics returned to baseline (EM recovered). canary id 2026-03-18-chi
infra-bot: deploy: canary rollback initiated by @jin — rolling back fp8-kernel for model redwood/13b-cp on l40s-pool-3 (canary 4%).
alex: can we avoid full rollback? suggestions: 1) add KV-tiling boundary fix + test, 2) mask FP8 enable for longseq path (>4096), or 3) add runtime fallback to fp16 when activation-clamp anomaly detected.
liam: i have a small patch that enables runtime fallback (checks activation variance every N steps) — tests locally. PR: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/7823
devon: prefer adding a short-circuit at kernel handshake: if old_kv_len % tile_size != 0 then force scalar path. cheaper and safer for now.
maria: for triage, we should run AWQ/GPTQ baselines too to confirm regression is FP8-specific. i'll queue those jobs on the bench farm.
jin: started long-run jobs: awq-baseline-2623, gptq-baseline-2624, fp8-debug-dump-2625.
alex: immediate action items: @liam open a canary PR with the fallback, @devon prototype the handshake check, @maria run AWQ/GPTQ comparison and post diffs. we'll keep rollback until one of these lands.
alex: add metric watchlist for canary: per-example EM, token-level KL to fp16, activation-variance, kv-tiling-mismatch counter. link to perf dash: https://dash.internal/redwood/canary/262345
liam: noted. i’ll also add a small unit test that simulates non-aligned KV extend.
maria: sharing raw dumps in #eng-ml-artifacts/262345 — includes clip histograms and scale traces.
alex: thanks — good catch everyone. ping me if you need extra GPU for longer canaries. :thumbsup:
